description: List the forms attached to one of the organization's conferences — the call for papers, the registration form, and any decision forms — with how many questions each has and whether it is published. A form that is not published accepts nothing, so check this before concluding a conference is ready to receive submissions or registrations. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: list_forms
title: List an event's forms
